title: YU13-limit-order-book architecture
description: A genuine crossing limit-order book replaces price-triggered auto-fill inside the inherited Aeron Cluster ClusteredService. A committed order reaches the deterministic engine, which either rests it in its security's two-sided LimitBook or crosses it against resting opposite-side orders best-price-first, FIFO within a level, at the resting price. Every match books a trade on BOTH sides; the committed outputs feed the unchanged egress, gateway ack, trade-bridge, and CQRS read-model paths. Determinism, zero-allocation, and complete snapshot recovery are inherited unchanged; the snapshot now serializes the whole resting book.

nodes.label: FIX + REST counterparties
nodes.description: Two-sided marketable order flow: resting and aggressing orders on both sides of the book.

nodes.label: FIX/REST gateway tier
nodes.description: Terminates counterparty sessions, forwards screened orders through the cluster client, and correlates each committed egress ack — counting only direct (non-resting) order-lifecycle acks so counterparty resting-order updates never skew offer/ack accounting.

nodes.label: Aeron Cluster client
nodes.description: Forwards SBE ingress to the current leader and receives committed egress acks carrying the resting-update class byte.

nodes.label: Feed adapter
nodes.description: Sequences conflated price ticks and control updates as cluster ingress; ticks feed risk freshness and seed a security's mark only until its book first trades.

nodes.label: Aeron Cluster consensus (leader + followers)
nodes.description: Raft majority replicates one committed input log; log order IS the crossing book's time priority, identical on every member and replay.

nodes.label: MatchingEngine (crossing)
nodes.description: Applies each committed order on the single service thread: admits the limit on the price grid and inside the band, then rests it or crosses it against the opposite book.

nodes.label: Per-security LimitBook
nodes.description: Two-sided array-indexed price levels with intrusive FIFO queues of pooled orders; O(1) best-price lookup, append, reduce, and unlink; zero-allocation steady state.

nodes.label: Cluster snapshots + per-pod log PVC
nodes.description: Format 2: header carries book geometry, per-security band anchors precede open rows, and open rows in ascending-reference order rebuild each level's exact FIFO on restore.

nodes.label: Committed output egress
nodes.description: Both sides of every match emit an order update, a booked trade, and a position update; the resting side is flagged FLAG_RESTING_UPDATE.

nodes.label: Leader trade-egress bridge
nodes.description: Republishes every booked trade to NATS /trades — two per cross (both sides), each keyed by its own tradeSeq+side.

nodes.label: Projector / read-model
nodes.description: Projects order lifecycle, two-sided fills, and positions to the read model.

nodes.label: NATS (pricing, control, distribution)
nodes.description: Inherited pricing/control feeds and output distribution, including the /trades bridge.

nodes.label: MariaDB read model
nodes.description: Persisted trades and positions from committed crossing outputs.
